reference.name: Renaming a dashboard records an unrelated changed pin position in History
reference.summary: Renaming a dashboard records an unrelated changed pin position in History.
reference.expected: A title-only rename records only the rename in History.
reference.actual: History reads renamed this Dashboard … and changed pin position after only the title was edited.
reproSteps: Open a dashboard in a collection that has pinned dashboards and choose Duplicate > Only duplicate the dashboard, so the copy shifts the existing pin positions.
On the copy, rename the dashboard inline, changing only its title.
Reload, open More info > History, and read the latest entry: it also claims a pin-position change.

knownHits.reason: History falsely adds a pin-position change to an unrelated operation, matching the reviewed history defect. Model trash/restore differs from the dashboard-rename reproduction.
